items.markdown:
When looking for top-tier medical negligence representation in Sydney, legal rankings and industry peer reviews (such as [Doyle's Guide](https://doylesguide.com/leading-medical-negligence-compensation-lawyers-plaintiff-new-south-wales-2026/) ) consistently highlight `a core group of leading plaintiff-focused lawyers and law firms`.[[1]](https://doylesguide.com/leading-medical-negligence-compensation-lawyers-plaintiff-new-south-wales-2026/)[[2]](https://doylesguide.com/leading-medical-negligence-compensation-law-firms-new-south-wales-2026/)

The leading plaintiff-focused medical negligence lawyers and firms in New South Wales/Sydney are structured below by their peer-awarded standing:

### Preeminent & Leading Medical Negligence Lawyers (Plaintiff)

- *Libby Brookes* ([Maurice Blackburn](https://www.mauriceblackburn.com.au/injury-illness/medical-injury/medical-negligence-lawyers-sydney/) ) – Recognized in the top 'Preeminent' bracket for her extensive expertise in handling complex medical injury and negligence compensation claims.[[1]](https://www.mauriceblackburn.com.au/injury-illness/medical-injury/medical-negligence-lawyers-sydney/)[[2]](https://doylesguide.com/leading-medical-negligence-compensation-lawyers-plaintiff-new-south-wales-2026/)
- *Kate Henderson* (Beilby Poulden Costello ) – Noted for her specialist background in complex personal injury and birth-related medical malpractice claims.[[1]](https://www.bestlawyers.com/australia/sydney/medical-negligence)[[2]](https://doylesguide.com/leading-medical-negligence-compensation-lawyers-plaintiff-new-south-wales-2026/)
- *Bill Madden* ([Carroll & O'Dea Lawyers](https://www.codea.com.au/personal-injury-compensation-lawyers/services/medical-negligence/) ) – A widely respected figure in health law, medical negligence, and associated regulatory/coronial inquiries.[[1]](https://doylesguide.com/leading-medical-negligence-compensation-lawyers-plaintiff-new-south-wales-2026/)[[2]](https://www.bestlawyers.com/australia/sydney/medical-negligence)
- *Kate Williams* (Kate Williams Medical Law Specialists ) – Highly specialized practitioner focusing exclusively on medical law and plaintiff-side clinical malpractice.[[1]](https://doylesguide.com/leading-medical-negligence-compensation-lawyers-plaintiff-new-south-wales-2026/)
- *Kasarne Burgan* (Burgan Lawyers ) – Recognized for dedicated advocacy on behalf of plaintiffs in complex medical litigation.[[1]](https://doylesguide.com/leading-medical-negligence-compensation-lawyers-plaintiff-new-south-wales-2026/)
- *Courtenay Poulden* (Beilby Poulden Costello ) – Ranked as a preeminent practitioner with deep experience in medical negligence trials.[[1]](https://doylesguide.com/leading-medical-negligence-compensation-lawyers-plaintiff-new-south-wales-2026/)

### Top-Tier Law Firms for Medical Negligence (Plaintiff-Focused)

If you are looking at the firm level, these practices hold **First Tier** rankings in NSW for plaintiff compensation:[[1]](https://doylesguide.com/leading-medical-negligence-compensation-law-firms-new-south-wales-2026/)

- *Beilby Poulden Costello* – Known for robust litigation in high-stakes medical malpractice and personal injury.
- *Carroll & O'Dea Lawyers* – Features a heavy-hitting team with deep expertise in medical negligence, institutional abuse, and professional liability.
